q: The topological pressure P(φ) for a Hölder potential φ on a mixing SFT equals log λ_φ where λ_φ is:
opts: The spectral radius of the adjacency matrix A
The maximal eigenvalue of the weighted adjacency matrix A_φ with (A_φ)ᵢⱼ = Aᵢⱼ e^{φ([ij])}
exp: For a 1-step shift with Markov potential φ = φ([ij]) depending only on the transition, P(φ) = log(spectral radius of A_φ). This generalises the SFT entropy formula (φ=0: P(0) = log ρ(A)) and is the foundation of the Gibbs measure theory for SFTs.
